review_type: Agent text-to-text inspection, not clinician adjudication or listening review
selection: Illustrative confirmed discrepancies; not an exhaustive error count or preregistered severity score

findings.report_quote: No signs of severe infection or dehydration requiring immediate intervention.
findings.explanation: The conversation establishes tolerating fluids and a conservative plan, not an examination or explicit exclusion of severe infection/dehydration.

findings.issue: Unasked travel history becomes a negative finding
findings.report_quote: No travel history, smoking, or alcohol use.
findings.explanation: Smoking and alcohol were discussed; travel was not. Not mentioned is not the same as denied.

findings.report_quote: Differential includes allergic contact dermatitis or other dermatitis, but eczema flare favored based on history.
findings.explanation: The clinician discusses a possible eczema flare and possible triggers, not this differential diagnosis. Plausibility does not make this a documented clinical assessment.

findings.issue: Invents an explanation for examination limitations
findings.report_quote: Not physically examined due to remote consultation; assessment based on patient description.
findings.explanation: Remote consultation is not established by the supplied transcript. The clinician says 'having looked at your skin', so this contradiction/ambiguity should be retained rather than resolved by guessing.

findings.issue: Invents why a differential was not explored
findings.report_quote: Differential not fully explored due to remote consultation and poor audio quality.
findings.explanation: Poor audio is stated; neither remote setting nor a causal explanation for the clinician's differential is established.

findings.report_quote: Vor etwa sechs Jahren depressive Episode nach Trennung
findings.source_quote: eine depressive Episode vor ein paar Jahren
findings.explanation: The ASR says a few years ago, not six. Six weeks refers to the current symptoms. This is a downstream fidelity error without needing to assume that the audio transcription is correct.

findings.issue: Conditional pre-examination assessment becomes established exclusion
findings.source_quote: wenn ich das finde, was ich erwarte, dann haben Sie
findings.explanation: The clinician says examination is still to follow and frames the expected viral explanation conditionally. No bacterial-superinfection exclusion was established.

findings.report_quote: mit befristetem Vertrag, das in sechs Monaten endet.
findings.source_quote: wir sind jetzt gut halb durch
findings.explanation: The project lasts six months and is already about halfway through; six months remaining is not supported.

findings.issue: Specific disease label silently reconstructed from corrupted rheumatology terms
findings.report_quote: In der Familie (Großtante) ist eine rheumatoide Arthritis bekannt.
findings.explanation: Dialogue context strongly suggests rheumatism, but the ASR does not establish the great-aunt's exact disease subtype. Rheumatoid arthritis is plausible, not independently verified. The model should retain that uncertainty.

findings.issue: Birth year lost in ASR and absent from report
findings.explanation: ASR preserved the day/month but dropped 1963. The report does not invent a year, but the missing year should be made explicit when used as a patient identification field.

ASR changed Oligurie to Aligorie. The ASR-based note omits the concept; the reference-based control preserves it. Tachycardia and hematocrit 53% remain, so the general case is recognizable while a potentially important finding disappears.
findings.origin: asr information corruption followed by summarizer omission

findings.issue: Control also adds an unsupported qualifier
findings.explanation: The conversation discusses gastroenteritis possibly caused by viruses or bacteria, not a post-infectious condition. Perfect reference input does not eliminate downstream additions.

reference_note_conflicts: English consultation01 clinician note says bilious vomiting; transcript says normal food-coloured vomit.
Consultation01 note says wife and children unwell; dialogue identifies one vomiting child and no identical household illness.
Consultation01 note says review in 3-5 days; spoken plan says 3-4 days.
Consultation02 note lists Betnovate BD and Cetraben QDS; those names/doses are not in the transcript, which discusses unspecified stronger steroid/emollient and fexofenadine.
Consultation02 note says review 10-14 days; spoken plan says next week if not improving.

Consultation02 patient corrects distribution to chest/hands/inside elbows; clinician later says chest/back. Both source inconsistency and note mismatch must be preserved rather than selecting a convenient gold answer.
